subject: Audit logs & data access evidence — follow-up from discovery call
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@fincobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Audit logs & data access evidence — follow-up from discovery call

Hi Laura — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and next steps on the audit/logging items you raised: 

1) Scope: You want concrete evidence showing who accessed customer data (query-level and blob export access) including timestamps, principal, action (read/export/delete), and resource identifiers.
2) Retention: Current default retention is 365 days for detailed audit records; we can extend retention for enterprise plans or ship periodic exports if you need longer retention windows.
3) Export formats & delivery: We can produce export samples in CSV or Parquet with ISO-8601 timestamps, and provide a signed delivery link (pre-signed S3) or SFTP.
4) Residency: Logs are stored in the region where the customer’s deployment is hosted; for your case (us-east-1) logs remain in us-east-1 by default.
5) Evidence packages: We can provide a SOC 2 evidence bundle (redacted where appropriate) and a sample audit-log extract showing relevant events.

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll share a sanitized sample audit log (CSV) for the timeframe you requested (2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-28).
- Ben / Marissa will prepare the SOC2 evidence summary and a short README for the export format and field glossary.
- Please confirm whether you prefer CSV or Parquet and whether delivery via SFTP or pre-signed link is required.

If that aligns, we’ll aim to send the sample + evidence pack by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: none in this message

From: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@fincobank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit logs & data access evidence — follow-up from discovery call

Thanks Aditya — that summary is helpful. A couple of clarifications from our security team: 

- We need to see both application-level access (API calls that returned model outputs) and infra-level operations (e.g., blob/object storage exports). Can you confirm both are surfaced in your audit pipeline?
- For the sample, please include events that show: user_id or service principal, action (read/write/export/delete), resource id (dataset/model/asset), ip address, and the exact timestamp (UTC).
- Retention: 365 days is a good start. For our internal compliance we may need proof that records older than X days were not modified; do you provide immutability or tamper-evident hashes for audit buffers?
- Delivery: pre-signed S3 link is preferred. For large exports we may request a one-time SFTP drop.

Also, please redact PII on the sample but keep consistent identifiers so we can correlate events.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Laura Jenkins
Head of Security
FinCoBank
laura.jenkins@fincobank.com

Subject: FW: Audit logs & data access evidence — follow-up from discovery call

Aditya — looping in ops and security to assemble the requested artifacts. Action items for internal owners below: 

- Ben: prepare a sanitized CSV extract covering 2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-28 that includes fields: event_id, timestamp_utc, principal_id (redacted), action, resource_id, ip_address, request_id, result (success/fail). Ensure ISO-8601 timestamps and UTC.
- Marissa: assemble the SOC2 evidence summary and include references to control IDs where we log access (e.g., access-control-logs-1). Include a short README describing field glossary and redaction approach.
- Neha (security eng): confirm whether we can provide tamper-evident SHA256 digests for exported files and add a brief note about our immutable append-only log window.

Target: send the sample + evidence bundle to Laura (pre-signed S3 link) by EOD today (Fri). If any of you need extra time, flag now.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success (Security)
Redwood Inference

Hi Laura — attaching the sanitized sample and the SOC2 evidence summary per your ask. Quick notes on contents: 

- audit-log-sample-20260306.csv (attached): CSV with columns event_id,timestamp_utc,principal_id,action,resource_id,ip_address,request_id,result. Sample has PII redacted but consistent pseudonymous principal_ids so you can correlate across events. Timestamps are in UTC (ISO-8601).
- redwood-soc2-evidence-summary-20260306.zip (attached): README + control mappings + a short note from our security engineering team about append-only logging and retention policies. Contains a checksums.txt with SHA256 digests for the CSV to demonstrate tamper-evidence.

Delivery: pre-signed S3 link below (expires in 72 hours). If you prefer SFTP for a larger export, let us know and we’ll arrange a secure drop.

Pre-signed link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/FIN-2026-0347/audit-pack-20260306?X-Amz-Expires=259200

Retention: as noted, detailed audit events are retained for 365 days. For extended retention, we can configure archival snapshots or provide periodic exports on a cadence you choose.

Please confirm receipt and whether the sample answers your immediate needs or if you want additional fields (e.g., full request payloads, agent user-agents).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
